name: Airship Assault
desc:
Airship Assault is a team-deathmatch game focused on aerial combat. Whether you choose to rule the sky with your trusty plane or defend your airship, you play a pivotal part in your team's success.

Created by Amir & Heedicalking
Inspired by myrkrwarrior's classic "Zeppelin Battle" from 2008 and "Zeppelin Wars" by IoIkiller101.

Playable on PC, Mobile, and Console.
